chapter_number.means: the chapter's number («I»…); empty — the prologue, the epilogue, the whole play, the very beginning

chapter_title.means: the chapter's name — in the strip's big frame (no map) or in the heading over the map; empty together with the number and no map — the very beginning: the lamp alone

map.means: null — only the title in one big frame; else the rows of choices [{title, weight '⚑'|'~', options: [{label, state: 'chosen'|'open'|'unseen'}]}]: a row is a frame cut into parts by its options; the chosen one glows warm, its label dark on the light; the one missed dark, its label barely seen; the one never reached black, no word; ⚑ — big frames, ~ — small ones; up to five rows — one strip (if the labels do not fit — two), more — the whole play: three strips (4 + 3 + 3)

reveal.means: 0 — the strip has not come in yet; the first third — it comes in from the right into the lamp's light, then the frames develop one by one; 1 — all seen

lamp.means: the brightness of the projector's lamp at the bottom right (the element lamp; the game offers to press it)
